correctness.rationale: The fixed C-infinity coefficient construction is positive where required, compactly supported, and independent of epsilon. Two-cell exact affine moments give sampled forcing p=2+epsilon^2 and sampled drift q=1-2epsilon^2, while midpoint policy matrices are exactly 2 and 3. The nonresidual branch images reverse the switch, proving an all-start two-cycle; the residual map becomes an affine contraction after the first step with exact rate 2epsilon^2/3 and biased root. Strictly increasing consistent residual F_0(a)=2(a-1)+(a-1)_+ has unique root 1. A separate exact-rational checker reproduces eight sample cases. This finite check supports but is not substituted for the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: The central pre-existing qualitative fact is quadrature-induced failure of policy iteration, from Hall et al. (2026). The distinct assessed claim is the fixed smooth one-degree-of-freedom construction with two positive symmetric degree-one-exact quadratures at arbitrarily small separation, exact global cycle and strict moment phase classification, together with an exact contrasting residual linear rate and bias. Classical exact Howard convergence theorems require consistent policy residuals and therefore do not dominate this mismatch. Some specialized unindexed or uninspected equivalence remains possible.
residual_risks: Some additional specialized inexact-Howard/quadrature literature may contain an equivalent smooth one-node construction that was not indexed by the completed searches.
The qualitative warning about mismatched quadrature was already published in 2026 and is not part of the originality claim.

value.rationale: The result rules out any unconditional positive quadrature-mismatch tolerance for convergence, despite smooth fixed coefficients, stable/strictly monotone consistent discrete equations and matched low-order exactness. It gives a minimal reproducible mechanism and the exact nonlinear residual bias and contraction factor, allowing direct discrimination between nonresidual chattering and residual slowdown. The policy tie at the discrete solution is an explicit essential boundary, not concealed in a broad claim.
